description: Source code for the mod_vhost module implementing virtual hosting in lighttpd 2, including functions for creating, managing, and freeing vhost mappings and regex-based mappings.

classes.name: vhost_map_data
classes.description: Data structure for storing host-to-action mappings.

classes.name: vhost_map_regex_entry
classes.description: Entry for regex-based host mapping, containing compiled regex and associated action.

classes.name: vhost_map_regex_data
classes.description: Data structure for regex host mappings, including list of entries and default action.

methods.name: vhost_map
methods.description: Handler function for host mapping based on hash table lookup.

methods.name: vhost_map_free
methods.description: Function to free resources allocated for vhost_map_data.

methods.name: vhost_map_create
methods.description: Creates a host mapping from a key-value list, returning an action.

methods.name: vhost_map_regex
methods.description: Handler function for regex-based host mapping.

methods.name: vhost_map_regex_free
methods.description: Function to free resources allocated for vhost_map_regex_data.

methods.name: vhost_map_regex_create
methods.description: Creates regex-based host mappings from key-value list, returning an action.

methods.name: plugin_vhost_init
methods.description: Initializes the vhost plugin with options, actions, and setups.
